Brief description of the changes.

## Task ID
`T-__-___` from the Task Tracker sheet.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Feature (new functionality)
- [ ] Bug Fix
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] Docs / Comments
- [ ] Test
- [ ] Chore (deps, CI, config)

## Screenshots / Recordings
If UI change, attach before/after screenshots.

## Testing
- [ ] Unit tests added / updated
- [ ] E2E tests added / updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Manually tested locally

## Checklist — Definition of Done
- [ ] Code follows ESLint + Prettier (zero warnings)
- [ ] UI uses ONLY design tokens — no hardcoded colors, fonts, or spacing
- [ ] TypeScript strict mode passes, no `any` without justification
- [ ] API routes protected with JWT + RLS check
- [ ] Sensitive keys encrypted via key vault (if applicable)
- [ ] No secrets, PII, or card data in logs
- [ ] Input validated with Zod on client AND server
- [ ] Keyboard-navigable, focus states visible, ARIA labels on icon-only buttons
- [ ] PR description explains what and why
- [ ] New env vars added to `.env.example` with comments
- [ ] Sentry integrated for new error surfaces
